name: hx1-bad-chainlock-then-connect
description: B86..B110 headers (fork A85) known before a lock on header-only A100 while A90 is the tip: enforcement's walk stops at A90, so B86 stays unmarked; B's data makes ConnectTip(B86) fail bad-chainlock (HasConflictingChainLock, occurrence 1); B111's header takes the lazy m_failed_blocks walk; a lock on B110 resets the failure flags and the same B86 bytes connect (occurrence 2)
